chapter: Bebop, Tadd Dameron, Slam Stewart and Europe
title: Freddy Webster and Dameron in Cleveland circles
summary: Trumpeter Freddy Webster played for Collins and his godmother, and the three hung out together.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: But Tad -- incidently was from Cleveland and so was Freddy Webster. Freddy Webster was a beautiful trumpet player, lyrical. He would come by my house and at 12:00 o'clock at night and bring his horn and play with no mute -- and I was living with my godmother then, who was also incidently a very good musician. And he played so pretty she would never say anything, and she would just sit and listen, and asked me, who was that. He just was so beautiful. But the three of us would kind of hang out together, Fred Webster and Tad and myself.
